free_tier.stated: No standing token allowance. Billing draws from free credit first and then from the paid balance, free credit can expire, and no credit amount is published on the pages read. The preview speech models stepaudio-3-realtime-preview and stepaudio-3-chat-preview are listed Free (limited time). Text reasoning is paid: step-3.5-flash is USD 0.10 per 1M cache-miss input and USD 0.30 per 1M output

limits.value: tier V0 for cumulative top-up under USD 15: concurrency 5, 100 RPM, 500,000 TPM; the tier rises only with cash top-ups, and vouchers do not count

binding_note: rate tier follows cumulative cash top-up; an account with no top-up starts at the lowest tier
